name: Temporal Index
description: Creates temporal signals and transcripts, consuming completed per-clip semantic profiles for regional motion as they arrive.

inputs.name: clip_catalog
inputs.description: Catalog rows used by semantic_index to join action labels to temporal clip ids by path or source stem.

inputs.name: audio_catalog
inputs.description: State input: audio_catalog - the catalog's audio-only entries in audio_001 numbering. Absent on runs whose catalog predates it; empty on video-only projects.

outputs.name: temporal_event_indices
outputs.description: Per-clip temporal summaries, including compact regional motion, fused crop, and keep-clear evidence for selected action spans.

outputs.name: total_reused
outputs.description: Clips whose per-clip index was reused from disk rather than re-transcribed. `may_be_empty` because ZERO IS THE CORRECT VALUE on any run that transcribed fresh - which is every first run, and was project 001's run of record. run_pipeline.validate_step_output treats any `total_*` output of 0 as semantically empty, so without this the honest answer was reported as a defect.

outputs.name: audio_indices
outputs.description: State output: audio_indices - one sound-only index per cataloged audio file (speech regions in the project's language, energy, onsets, events). Empty on video-only projects, which is the normal case. Read by the voiceover/music spine: speech_sequence aligns voiceover passages off it, and music_selection catalogues held beds from it; the per-audio files beside the video indices are the artifact.
